summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of 'Manage Payments' pages. All 7 new payment-related pages (3 user pages, 4 admin pages) load correctly and are accessible via their respective sidebars. User sidebar 'Manage Payments' menu expands correctly showing Payment Methods, Plans & Billing, My Coupons, and Transaction History links. Admin sidebar 'Manage Payments' menu expands correctly showing Payment Gateways, Plans, Coupons, Tax Rates, and Transactions links.
